sentences.en: Whoever wakes me up shall know the torments of Hell.
sentences.zh: 无论谁把我叫醒，都将尝到地狱般的痛苦。

sentences.en: Even when he was a child, Fadil tormented his siblings.
sentences.zh: 即使在小时候，法迪尔也常常捉弄他的兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: He confessed the crime because he was tormented by guilt.
sentences.zh: 他因为内疚而承认了罪行。

senses.zh: （尤指精神上的）折磨，痛苦；苦难之源
使备受折磨；使痛苦；烦扰；戏弄；捉弄；纠缠

mnemonic: 词根记忆：tor（=tort扭曲）+ment→扭的状态→折磨
